plan.notes: Source: official UWM 2026-2027 Academic Catalog page 'Computer Science, BS' (College of Engineering & Applied Science), 'Sample Plan of Study for the Computer Science Major' grid, transcribed by hand on 2026-09-30 from https://catalog.uwm.edu/engineering-applied-science/computer-science/computer-science-bs/. Catalog year 2026-2027 confirmed via the UWM announcement 'UWM's 2026-2027 academic catalog is published' (https://uwm.edu/news/uwms-2026-2027-academic-catalog-is-published/) and the live catalog header 'All pages in the 2026-2027 Catalog'. 8 semesters (Fall Year 1 through Spring Year 4), 41 slots, credit totals per semester 15/15/15/14/15/15/16/15 = 120 credits, matching the catalog's stated 120-credit degree total. All course codes, titles, and credits are verbatim from the official plan grid. Prerequisites are NOT listed per slot in the plan grid; prereq arrays were transcribed from the official 2026-2027 catalog course listings (COMPSCI, MATH, IND ENG, EAS, ENGLISH, INFOST course pages at catalog.uwm.edu/courses/ and catalog PDFs) on 2026-09-30. Standing-based prerequisites (junior/senior/sophomore standing) and Math/English placement requirements cannot be represented as course codes and are documented in choice_note fields; placement/assessment details also noted here per validator rules. Caveats: (1) The official grid contains unnamed blank rows — 1 credit in Year 1 Semester 2 and Year 2 Semester 1, and 3 credits in Year 2 Semester 2, Year 3 Semester 2, Year 4 Semester 1, and Year 4 Semester 2 — which count toward the published semester totals; these are rendered as student-choice 'GENERAL ELECTIVE' slots (the catalog names no course for them). (2) The MATH 105/MATH 108 slot reflects the official or-alternative; both options are named. (3) COMPSCI 657 is the catalog's 'Topics in Computer Science:' special-topics course. (4) Footnote 1: 6 credits of Natural Science are required by the major (GEO SCI 102 + ASTRON 103 here) and can also count toward the GER Natural Science and Wellness requirement. Footnote 2: MATH 211 is required by the major and also counts toward the GER Mathematics and Quantitative Reasoning requirement. (5) The catalog's preparatory-coursework disclaimer applies: based on placement results, some students must complete English, developmental math, or First Year Bridge support courses before enrolling. (6) Degree name is the catalog's true program name 'Computer Science, BS' (College of Engineering & Applied Science). No substitutions made.
